name: firm-cost-of-inaction
description: Builds a worksheet of what waiting costs the client, with each consequence in the client's own figures, who said it and when, arithmetic shown step by step on their figures only, the timing pressure they stated and what changes if they wait a quarter, blanks left blank with the question to ask. Use for "run firm-cost-of-inaction", "what does waiting cost them", "cost of doing nothing", "there is no urgency on their side", "why would they act this quarter", "build the case from their own numbers", "they like me and nothing moves", part of the Claude for Consultants · Team in Claude Pack by 90n.
